fusions.name: Flechette Round
fusions.desc: Fires a point at high speed into the first enemy it meets, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Spray of Pins
fusions.desc: Blasts pins in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything caught in it, each with a 15% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Barrel
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Powder Already Lit
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you deal 25% more physical damage for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
